SCHEDULE 3 - DATA PROTECTION UNDERTAKINGS
Synthetic test document. Fictional parties. No legal effect.
7.1 Purpose. Personal data shall be processed only for the purposes stated in Schedule A and for no other purpose.
7.2 Instructions. The Provider shall process personal data only on the documented instructions of the Client.
7.3 Personnel. All personnel with access to personal data shall be bound by written duties of confidentiality.
7.4 Security. The Provider shall maintain appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.
7.5 Sub-processors. The Provider shall not engage a sub-processor without the prior written authorisation of the Client.
7.6 Assistance. The Provider shall assist the Client in responding to requests from data subjects within ten (10) business days.
7.7 Breach Notice. The Provider shall notify the Client without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.
7.8 Audit. The Client may audit the Provider's compliance with this Schedule once in any period of twelve (12) months on thirty (30) days' notice.
